item.title: 2026.07.27.f539f2f
item.description:
Account management + live menu bar + reliability fixes

  • Switch accounts in Settings → Accounts — per-account usage, Promote, rename/delete inline.
  • Menu-bar readout (opt-in) — active account's usage % and/or a countdown to the next refresh.
  • "Re-login needed" + Re-link — expired logins are flagged and re-captured from a fresh claude login, no duplicate.
  • Token-billed accounts read "No plan usage · token-billed"; extra-credits allowance now shows.

Diagnostics: usage polling logs a clear "no Claude engine found" line instead of failing silently.

Updates: now checks hourly (was daily).

Fixed: a false "app is behind the daemon" version-mismatch banner on fresh installs (thanks to The Persian Prince for the catch).

Fixed: sessions no longer drop (the heartbeat never refreshes your active login); each account shows its own usage; account switching reliably keeps the freshest token; OAuth tokens are never logged.

Signed & notarized. Requires macOS 14+ and Claude Code.

item.title: 2026.07.25.a3f88b8
item.description:
Automatic updates are here

First release with built-in updates — tokenbank now updates itself in place.

  • New: Automatic updates (Sparkle). Background checks and one-click install, cryptographically signed. Manual check in Settings → General → Check Now.
  • Fixed: Settings window (General / Accounts / Log) no longer opens cramped or clipped, sizes correctly, and shows a proper title.

Signed (Developer ID: Archaitect B.V.) and notarized. Requires macOS 14+ and Claude Code.
